passage_paragraphs: Thermal technologies have been used in the food industry for over 100 years, providing a way of preserving food in large batches. Recent advancements in ohmic heating were made through research in Chile on the preservation of strawberries. Ohmic heating is generally considered to be an improvement over more conventional thermal methods: whereas conventional methods transfer energy from the surface of a food to its interior, ohmic heating passes electric current through food products to generate heat within the food itself.
